cases.query_text: How many Harborwick crate tags did the Pebbleford shop count on Maple Shift?

passages.text: Maple Shift crate log: Harborwick Shelf Lamp crate tags counted = 14.
The shop kettle was refilled twice during Maple Shift.
Window glass on Bay 2 was wiped after lunch.
A spare ribbon spool was moved to the side bench.
The floor chalk mark near the door was redrawn.
Someone borrowed the green stool and returned it.
A visitor asked where the coat hooks were.
The leftover twine ball sat on the window ledge.
Bay 3 lights flickered once and then stayed on.
The closing bell was tested and put away.

Mossgate card B: packing lane letter is M.

cases.query_text: What loom-batch code is recorded for the Quillmere scarf?

passages.text: Nearby shop talk mentioned batch ZX-99 for a different scarf.
A draft card guessed the code might be QQ-01.
Someone wrote maybe LB-12 on a scrap and crossed it out.
The tea tin label was not a loom-batch code.
Quillmere official loom card: scarf loom-batch code is LB-44.
A later rumor said the code was LB-88. That rumor is not the card.
The window list mentioned colors, not batch codes.
A visitor guessed LB-44 but did not write it on the official card.
The floor slate had a doodle that looked like LB-00.
Closing notes mentioned leftover yarn, not a batch code.
